description: User 18.11.2026: door opened after a successful lockpick, out-of-air pulses synced to the drowning damage ticks (red flash), waterfall loop (mod v46 waterfall:start/complete). Bank env (haptics/forge/env.forge.json). Candidates until confirmed in game.

rules.note: Only after lp:complete res=open (action unlockdoor): latch gives at 0.22 s, the door swings 0.42-1.8 s of the 2.1 s push animation (montage has no notifies: timing [Г], tune from the game)
18.11: replaces the generic auto 'choking'. Fallback 1 Hz throb ONLY until the first drowning damage tick; from then on drown-pulse plays each tick in sync with the red flash

19.11 (game: the screen flashed red, nothing was felt - v46 waited for damage that had not come yet): mod v47 reads the hero's oxygen; below the critical level (red warning) one choking beat per oxygen:update src=beat, 1.1 s at the critical level -> 0.5 s when empty, stronger as the air runs out. Sync with the flash [Г]

Out of air: a drowning damage tick (action drown open = below the critical oxygen level) = one choking throb; a beat and a tick closer than 400 ms play once - whichever comes first (situation air, same priority); combat-take-hit skips these ticks

Under a waterfall (mod: hero inside the splash zone of an FMOD waterfall emitter): water pounding on the shoulders, looped until he steps out; k = strength 40..85 by waterfall size. 19.11.2026 level map (reports/levels.md): x0.75 (rms20 0.31 -> ~0.23) - a background loop was louder than everyday interactions (median 0.26), the user wants ambient quiet (game96)
